missingPoints: VISUAL_ANALYSIS_CDP_EXTRACT channel is declared in the IpcChannel enum but no ipcMain.handle is registered anywhere in main/ipc/*.ts
Renderer preload calls ipcRenderer.invoke(IpcChannel.VISUAL_ANALYSIS_CDP_EXTRACT) but Electron will reject with 'No handler registered' after ~30s timeout
No consumer code in src/ui/ currently invokes this channel, but the type contract exists and may be called by Studio modules in future — currently a channel-definition-with-no-handler

Initial state seeds agents: FALLBACK_AGENTS — a synchronous derivation from AGENT_META with description: '' (empty), capabilities: ACTIVE_CAPS (hardcoded {theme:true,hotReload:true,extension:false}), status: {installed:false,running:false,debugReady:false}
Until loadAgents() resolves, the UI shows agents with empty descriptions and hardcoded false availability flags
loadAgents() failure path leaves fallback data in place silently — no loading/error state in the store to flag degraded data
loadAgents() calls api.catalog.agents.list() which triggers core.status() IPC with a 15s timeout — under heavy load this can fail and leave stale fallback data
No retry mechanism and no error state exposed to UI — the console.error is the only signal
Store exposes no loading flag separate from loaded: false — components cannot differentiate 'not yet loaded' from 'loaded but empty'
loadAgents is called in useAppController's boot effect, but if the component unmounts before IPC resolves, the set() call hits a stale closure
VISUAL_ANALYSIS_STATUS channel has NO push emitter registered — the comment at lines 242-252 is a no-op stub
Preload subscribes onVisualAnalysisProgress via ipcRenderer.on but main never calls webContents.send for this channel
Studio FitGeneratorPanel or any progress consumer will see zero progress events during extraction
VISUAL_ANALYSIS_DETECT handler returns {running:false, port:undefined, title:undefined} when deps.getStatus is unavailable (line 221-223) — silently degrades without signaling to UI
When running in test/standalone mode, this is expected, but no log warning surfaces the degraded operation
StatTile for 'yourEnvironments' is hardcoded to value='—' (line 137) instead of showing envCount from useEnvironmentStore
Comment confirms intentional omission '现在这个页面 — 无-op' but no corresponding data wiring exists
STUDIO_BUNDLE_LIST returns createdAt: '' (empty string) for all bundles (line 176) — no filesystem stat call to populate real creation timestamp
name field falls back to entry.name (directory name) rather than reading manifest.json for a human-readable name
refreshThemes() catches errors and reports via notification but does NOT set empty state on failure — UI retains last successful list which may be stale
No lastError or stale flag for the theme catalog in the store
initialize() catches all errors silently (line 122-124) and just sets loading:false with empty wallpaper list — UI shows 'no wallpapers' even when Wallpaper Engine is installed but scanning failed
No error/degraded state to communicate initialization failure to the user

setAndApplyAgentWallpaper companion loop (wallpaper -> theme extract -> re-apply) is fire-and-forget with no status tracking — theme.extractThemeFromWallpaper and applyToApp failures inside the try block are only caught via notification, no store state update
STUDIO_SNAPSHOT_LOAD returns raw JSON.parse result cast directly to ThemeVisualSnapshot (line 330) without schema validation
Malformed snapshot.json from version mismatch or corruption will produce a runtime crash in downstream consumers expecting structured snapshot data
STUDIO_SNAPSHOT_SAVE uses JSON.stringify(req.snapshot) directly (line 297) with no schema validation — any object shape can be persisted, risking future deserialization failures

APP_BOOTSTRAP returns {themes: [], status: {apps: [], ...}} with empty arrays (lines 33-35) — intentionally defers to separate refresh calls per the comment, but UI has no bootstrap-phase loading state to differentiate 'bootstrapping' from 'bootstrapped with zero data'
Consumers receive a structurally complete but empty SystemStatus until the first status poll resolves
Initial state status: null (line 33) — components must null-check every status field
No initial auto-refresh triggered from within the store; relies entirely on useBoot's polling and STATUS_CHANGED push events

updateConcurrencyMetrics merges partial metrics (line 99-103) but the store has no staleness indicator — if main process stops broadcasting metrics (e.g., crash), UI shows last-known values indefinitely
No TTL or last-updated timestamp on ConcurrencyMetrics to detect stale diagnostics
loadProjectSnapshots catches errors (line 513-521) but sets snapshotError: null (line 516) instead of an error message — UI shows no feedback on snapshot load failure
baselines map is only partially populated for the current agentId; switching agents requires ensureBaseline to succeed but has no user-visible failure state
DEFAULT_AGENT: AgentId = 'codex' (line 115) hardcodes the initial preview window agent — if codex adapter is unavailable, the preview still renders for a non-functional agent
windowsForMode() creates windows with Date.now()-based IDs (line 108) which are non-deterministic and prevent reliable test assertions

exportTheme() passes (toolOverrides ?? undefined) as unknown as Record<string,unknown> (line 732) — double cast hides type mismatch; signature field may be undefined when toolOverrides are empty but the builder expects an object
buildStudioPalette(snapshot) can return undefined when snapshot.landmarks is empty, then mergeOverridesToSkinTokens(undefined, ...) is called with no null-guard
exportTheme checks `if (!project) return` (line 717) but the StudioProject | null type of getActiveProject() means a null project silently aborts export with no user feedback
loadProjectSnapshots catch block (line 513-521) sets snapshot to null and snapshotError to null + snapshotThemeName to '' — complete silent failure with no store-level error indication
UI cannot distinguish 'loading failed' from 'no snapshot exists'
loading state initialized to true (line 74) but the CSS textarea renders immediately regardless — no visual loading indicator for the custom CSS fetch
textarea placeholder text represents the only visible state; content appears only after async fetchCustomThemeCss resolves, but the text area appears empty during loading with no spinner
Boot-time catalog refresh (lines 225-241) runs inside requestAnimationFrame — if rAF is throttled (background tab), the deferred loadAgents/refreshThemes/initialize can be delayed indefinitely
No fallback timeout if rAF never fires
Empty state fallback `onRetry ?? (() => {})` (line 193, 232) provides no-op handler for retry when not passed — error banner's retry button does nothing if parent doesn't wire the callback
StatusErrorBanner renders with a literal no-op function, meaning the retry button calls an empty function

installFlowStore orchestrates theme installation via IPC but has no explicit 'rollback on failure' state for partial installations — if a step fails mid-flow, the store retains step progress without compensating cleanup
ENV_PRESET_GET returns [] on any error (line 27-29) — an unreadable/corrupt env-presets.json yields identical result to 'no presets exist', UI cannot communicate data loss vs empty

Renderer-side environment-store.ts local loadPresets() has a legacy localStorage migration (lines 64-80) that runs only when main returns empty — on a genuinely fresh install with no presets, this legacy path is wasted effort
loadPresets() silently returns [] on failure (line 94-96) — same 'indistinguishable from empty' problem as the IPC layer
rWarn is the only error signal, no store-level error flag
ACTIVE_CAPS is hardcoded to {theme:true, hotReload:true, extension:false} for ALL agents (line 28) — capabilities should be derived from actual adapter support but are instead a static constant
Fallback capabilities do not vary by agent despite real differences (e.g., some agents may not support hot-reload)
